from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DebtRepaymentEntry(BaseModel):
    """A debt repayment cash line item extracted from a company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name that filed this report")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., 2024年第一季度)")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the line item (e.g., '偿还债务支付的现金')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The reported amount; use None if not present or N/A")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency/unit (e.g., '元')")
    section: str | None = Field(description="Where in the statement this appears (e.g., '筹资活动产生的现金流量')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short excerpt showing the line item and value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    debt_repayment_entries: list[DebtRepaymentEntry]
